definition: Run the corrective rounds on the fast search: each round moves what the critic found, and is kept only if the house strictly improves with no new fatal error. The result loads as one undoable step; a refusal here is often the search's noise.
basis: Our wording of the loop on the search. docs/revise.md: "Accept only if the key strictly decreases and no new fatal appears."; the bench loads "the revised record as ONE undo step"; and "on the search engine a declared move is judged against re-placement noise and refused".
